description: Let the adventurer return from Kitchen to Studio along the active chimney cargo line after lowering the cinched sack

                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,STUDIO>
                <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>>

          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE>

           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,GRATING-ROOM>
                <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,TORCH-ROOM>
                ,DOME-FLAG
                <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>>
